name: Notification
summary: A card that reports something the reader did not ask about — a deployment finished, a certificate was renewed. It is wider than a message, and it carries a heading of its own.
summaryZh: 一张卡片,报告读者没有问过的事 —— 部署完成了、证书续期了。它比消息宽,而且自带一个标题。

variants.name: Info
variants.note: The default state, and the base class on its own.

variants.name: Error
variants.note: Element Plus calls this type error; the theme calls the same colour danger, so the class paints the danger role.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A narrow card, for a line of news.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default card needs no modifier class.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A wide card, for news that has a paragraph under its heading.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The close button is a real button, so the browser owns its focus and the ring is drawn around it.

parts.name: Status mark
parts.note: The disc beside the heading. The variant fills it with the state colour and draws the state's mark on it.

parts.name: Title
parts.note: The heading of the card. It is a heading element in the markup, so the reader can jump to it.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The body of the card. It keeps the mood's regular text colour.

parts.name: Close
parts.note: The button that dismisses the card. Its mark is drawn from two borders, not written as a character.

props.name: variant
props.descriptionZh: 这条通知表示哪一种状态。

props.name: size
props.description: The width of the card. The measures are in the card's own type, so the card grows with the mood's text.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片的宽度。宽度用的是卡片自己的字号单位,所以卡片会跟着 mood 的文字一起变大。

props.name: closable
props.description: Whether the card carries a close button.
props.descriptionZh: 卡片上是否带关闭按钮。

a11y.notes: The card is a plain container, so it carries no role of its own. A notification that arrives without the reader asking for it needs a live region: give it role="status", or role="alert" when the news is urgent. The status disc is decorative — the heading already says what happened — so hide it with aria-hidden. Put the heading in a real heading element, so the reader can navigate by it.
a11y.notesZh: 卡片本身只是一个容器,不带角色。读者没操作它就出现的通知需要一个 live region:给它 role="status";消息紧急时用 role="alert"。状态标记是装饰 —— 标题已经说了发生了什么 —— 用 aria-hidden 把它藏掉。标题要放在真正的标题元素里,读者才能靠它跳转。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Four states. The disc carries the state colour and the state's mark; the heading and the body keep the mood's own text colours.
examples.descriptionZh: 四种状态。圆盘承载状态色和状态记号,标题和正文还是 mood 自己的文字色。
examples.markup:
Reconciliation finished

The nightly run compared both regions and found no differences.

Deployment finished

Six replicas were moved to build 214, one at a time.

Storage at 68%

Two more connectors will exceed the plan limit.

Replica unreachable

The last sync failed 12 minutes ago.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three widths. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium card. The width is a measure of the card's own type, so it grows with the mood's text.
examples.descriptionZh: 三种宽度。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号卡片。宽度是卡片自己的字号单位,所以卡片会跟着 mood 的文字一起变大。
examples.markup:
Certificate renewed

A narrow card, for a line of news.

Certificate renewed

The default card.

Certificate renewed

A wide card, for news that has a paragraph under its heading.

examples.title: Announced
examples.description: A notification that arrives on its own needs a live region, so it is announced instead of waiting to be found. The close button is a real button.
examples.descriptionZh: 自己冒出来的通知需要 live region,这样它会被播报,而不是等着被看见。关闭按钮是真的按钮。
examples.markup:
Certificate renewed

The wildcard for *.internal was issued on 12 March and expires in 90 days.

notes: The card is laid out with a grid, so the status disc sits beside the heading and the body runs under the heading rather than under the disc. The width is written in em: a notification is a measure of text, and a measure that does not follow the type size stops being a measure the moment a mood changes its type.
notesZh: 卡片用网格排:状态标记在标题旁边,正文从标题底下起排,而不是从标记底下起排。宽度用的是 em —— 通知是文字的一行长短,而长短不跟着字号走的话,mood 一换字号它就不再是长短了。
